description: Replaced the buggy scalar parameter initialization logic in the GPT class to correctly map `x`, `x0`, `y`, and `lm_head` tensors to the class variables `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head` before any tensor operations, resolving the fatal optimizer initialization failure on the very first step by fixing the conditional variable assignment bug that caused the model to crash. This restores the val_bpb to a stable ~0.9914.
